Replace.Text: Eight early-game policy cards that reward settling far from home.
Adds Frontier Spirit, Craftsmen, Expeditions, Pilgrimage, Scholars, Delegations, Militia and Raiders.
Cities founded at least 6 tiles from your Capital begin with 25% of a Monument already built.
Builders trained in cities with 3 or fewer Population receive +1 Build Charge.
Settlers ignore movement penalties from Woods, Rainforest, Hills, and River crossings.
Cities founded at least 6 tiles from your Capital begin with +25 [ICON_FAITH] Faith.
Cities founded at least 6 tiles from your Capital receive +1 [ICON_SCIENCE] Science until they reach 7 Population.
The first time you discover a City-State, gain 25 Influence Points.
Units receive +5 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength while within 3 tiles of a city with 4 or fewer Population.
Units receive +2 [ICON_STRENGTH] Combat Strength while within 6 tiles of a city with 4 or fewer Population.
